title: Original engineering inputs in the common working view
summary: Fresh continuation after correcting the collector. The common view and actual backend response agree on the exact original-input digital run. Refresh/reload read its durable state without generation, execution, review or replay. Public common start remains separate.

manualSteps.label: Workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Open the isolated workspace and click Workflows.

manualSteps.label: Saved process
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflow files, Open workflow, then printed-replacement-part-prompt-default-055.workflow.wflow.

manualSteps.label: Common view
manualSteps.instruction: Click Use saved process. Inspect the original inputs and any readiness reason.

manualSteps.label: Run
manualSteps.instruction: Open the supplied exact-run link. Inspect progress and the declared basis review without approving it.
